** Minor** · **Stability & Availability** · **Quick win** **Wait for deletion to finish before checking the files.** `release.complete()` only unblocks the directory lookup. Session cleanup still runs without an awaited completion, so deletion that takes more than 10 ms makes this test fail even when cleanup succeeds. Expose the store in the fixture and await a same-UID `find` queued after `deleteAll` before checking the folder. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruxenb/LongvitaRC/d3487eac20cf37ac69607d02a5e3049b3e556105/test/report/session_cleanup_test.dart))

Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. Review comment at @test/report/session_cleanup_test.dart around lines 113 - 114: The test checks the folder before session cleanup has finished. Expose the store in the fixture, then after `release.complete()` await a same-UID `find` queued after `deleteAll` to ensure deletion has completed before checking the files; keep the existing directory-lookup release flow unchanged. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```
